newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Kenmare Resources H1 pretax loss 0.98 punts.
newsitem.headline: Kenmare Resources H1 pretax loss 0.98 punts.

text.p: Kenmare Resources Plc on Friday reported a pre-tax loss of 0.98 million Irish pounds for the half year ended June 30, 1996, up from 0.03 million a year earlier.
The loss per share was 0.76 pence against 0.03 pence, Kenmare said in a statement.

Kenmare said it had concentrated on developing large mineralized zones on its southern licence in the Niassa gold prospect in northern Mozambique in recent months to the point where they are ready for drilling operations.
"This work has been very successful with several zones having been identified and investigated in detail," the company said.
It also reported a strong improvement in sales from its Ancuabe graphite mine in northern Mozambique and said it would see the benefits of this in the second half of 1996.
"From a position where demand has been much lower than our production capacity we are now moving rapidly into a production constrained situation.
"This project has made great strides in the last few months and we are very hopeful of continuing progress in the latter half of the year."
The company's listing, which was supsended pending the announcement, was restored following the release of the results.
